title: Roof Repair in Milwaukie, OR
summary: In February 2026, French Roofing repaired a roof on a home in Milwaukie, OR. A low-slope section next to the shingled roof had a stained white surface with standing water and leaves on it. After the repair, that section is covered in new gray architectural shingles that run out to the roof edge.
scope: Covered the stained low-slope section with new gray architectural shingles
Ran the new shingles out to the metal edge along the back of the roof
body: Before the repair, the low-slope section at the back of the house had a white surface with dark stains, leaves, and water sitting in one corner. The photos below show that section before, and the same area afterward with new shingles on it.
